title_original: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 6 (Duties of the Chairperson)
(1) The chairperson shall represent the Committee and exercise overall control over its affairs.
(2) Where the chairperson is unable to perform duties for unavoidable reasons, the vice-chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf; where both are unable to perform their duties for unavoidable reasons, a member designated in advance by the chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf. <Amended on December 9, 2025>
